description:
We are Code Breakers, and today we are excited to share our project with you. To bring our ideas to life, we’ve prepared a PowerPoint presentation paired with a custom-built, DIY scale model of a jukebox floating in space.

Our presentation will walk you through the inspiration, design process, and technical concepts behind our work, while our handcrafted model serves as a tangible centerpiece that blends retro nostalgia with cosmic exploration.
summary: I really liked this project. We decided to make a Power Point about an Earth Jukebox and also did a site with soundtracks from Space. We also created a Roblox game showing how life would look on Mars.
details: If you acces the site, you can listen to soundtracks from different Space fenomens. Also, on the Roblox game you can see how the World would look on Mars. On the Power Point presentation we will explain how Earth Jukebox works.
